title: Synthetic Pagila OLTP
description: Mixed read/write OLTP transactions over a deterministic DVD-rental schema.

benchmark.init_command: ARG_PSQL_PATH -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h ARG_PG_HOST -p ARG_PG_PORT -U ARG_PG_USER -d ARG_PG_DATABASE -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/pagila-schema.sql && PG_PERF_BENCH_PSQL='ARG_PSQL_PATH' python3 ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/generator.py --scale ARG_WORKLOAD_SCALE && ARG_PSQL_PATH -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h ARG_PG_HOST -p ARG_PG_PORT -U ARG_PG_USER -d ARG_PG_DATABASE -c 'REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW pagila.rental_by_category; ANALYZE pagila.customer'
benchmark.workload_command: ARG_PGBENCH_PATH --no-vacuum --client=ARG_PGBENCH_CLIENTS --jobs=ARG_PGBENCH_CLIENTS --time=ARG_WORKLOAD_DURATION_SECONDS --progress=10 -h ARG_PG_HOST -p ARG_PG_PORT -U ARG_PG_USER -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/01_select.sql -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/02_insert.sql -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/03_update.sql -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/04_delete.sql ARG_PG_DATABASE
